usedFor: Nolt holds feedback posts, and Google Docs keeps a write-up of them through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Post Created” in Nolt, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new feedback post is written into a document tab your team can read.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's existing content, so choose adding to keep it.
